-- intro: :For the variety of curses used by Megicula, see Curse-Warding Magic.  Curse Magic , or Hex Magic, is a form of magic that allows the user to include additional lasting negative effects to spells.
-- Description:
    This form of magic allows the user to include additional lasting negative effects to spells. The effects can range from dulled senses to debilitating sickness and even death. The user is able to use this magic without the need of a grimoire. However, in order to use it to its full potential, specific spells are required, which are stored within grimoires. Curses placed on humans do not affect elves, even if they inhabit the same body. All curses derive from Megicula's power. The Agrippa Family has studied curses for hundreds of years and is infamous for its Curse Magic.
-- spell pages: Ash Absorbing Formation; Joyful Destructive Ash; Sekke Poison Lizard; Aufwachen Dachs; Dwelling of the Poison Cloud; Curse-Worker's Neighbor; Ultra Giant Bull
